headline: Get Skippy
title: How to Get Skippy | The Water Healer | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Skippy is a Water healer and one of the easiest Aniimo to catch. Look for it in Nimbus Fields, along the river on the west side. It also lives in The Mistwoods and the Forest of Falling Stars. At level twelve it evolves into Pranky, and at level twenty Pranky becomes Glacy or Leafy. Its Water Spirit trait cuts skill energy cost in water. Do you keep a Skippy? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Skippy is a Water healer found in Nimbus Fields, The Mistwoods and the Forest of Falling Stars. It evolves into Pranky at level 12, then into Glacy or Leafy at level 20.
